title: Document atoms (per-document index)
description: An atom is one distinct, citable policy statement in a source document, classified by primitive_type and tagged for fast downstream matching. Atomization is action-agnostic: a doc's atoms.jsonl is built once and reused across every action in the catalog. The on-disk artifact is one atom per line of releases/v2/data/atoms/<source_document_id>.jsonl; this schema defines a single atom row.

atom_id.description: Stable identifier of the form <source_document_id>_a_NNNN where NNNN is zero-padded sequential by document offset. Stable within an extraction run; treat as opaque for joins.

primitive_type.description: WHAT kind of policy statement this atom is. Closed vocabulary shared with action_findings.schema.json.

evidence_text.description: Verbatim substring of source document markdown. Whitespace runs may be collapsed but no other edits permitted.

evidence_offset.description: Character offset of evidence_text in the source document markdown. Filled in by the post-extraction verbatim resolver.

page.description: Page number from the nearest preceding <!-- page_break: N --> marker. Set by the offset-resolver after verbatim validation, not by the model directly.

page_end.description: End page when the atom spans multiple pages.

section.description: Nearest preceding ## section heading at the atom's offset.

atom_summary.description: One-sentence English summary of what the atom says. Used as the per-atom payload sent to the matching stage so the matcher can scan many atoms cheaply without re-reading every evidence_text.

sector_tags.description: Free-form-but-normalised sector or theme tags. Controlled vocabulary seeded by the atomization prompt: energy, transport, buildings, industry, waste, water, agriculture, forestry, biodiversity, ecosystems, urban_planning, coastal, health, disaster_risk, education, gender, indigenous, finance, governance, monitoring.

applicability_scope.description: Which territory the atom applies to when the source document covers a region or intercommunal area. Free text but should resolve to a region or commune name where possible.

measure_type.description: Whether the atom frames the statement as mitigation, adaptation, both, or unknown.

explicitness.description: explicit = atom states something directly; inferred = the atom is the model's plausible interpretation of a more diffuse passage.

primitive_relation_hint.description: Optional hint at how this atom usually relates to actions in its sector. Useful for downstream filtering. The matching stage may override this when computing the per-(action, atom) relation.

extraction_metadata.description: Per-atom provenance: model, chunk index, run timestamp. Useful for debugging recall regressions.
